statement: The record gives 15,000 rpm for batch B-12. I will not start it because rotor R-40 is rated for only 10,000 rpm; the run must be corrected or use a suitably rated rotor.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the recorded speed exceeds the rotor's rating ("rotor R-40 is rated for only 10,000 rpm") and refuses to run it.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
